name: Aga (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Aga town emblem in green, yellow and light blue: a green ring open at the top with a yellow disc, above light blue wavy lines.
history: Municipal flag of Aga, a town in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2005.
